test_PyProcess: test the PyProcess class to wrap a Python object and expose its methods as TensorFlow operations
test_PyProcessHook: test the PyProcessHook to integrate wrapped Python processes with TensorFlow sessions
test_PyProcess_proxy: test the PyProcess proxy to call Python methods as TensorFlow ops with tensor specs
test_error_handling_constructor: test error handling when a PyProcess constructor raises an exception during session run
test_error_handling_method: test error handling when a PyProcess wrapped method raises an exception during session run
